item.description:
### One screen to build a block list
Choosing what a session blocks used to open an empty picker, and then a second card on top of it just to make a list. Now the screen *is* the editor: it opens ready for a new list, with **Use Existing** at the bottom to pull in one you already saved — pre-filled, so you can adjust it before saving. Save sets it on the session in one step.
### Sessions appear on Home right away
Start an instant block from the Blocker screen and it now shows up in Home's running-sessions card immediately, instead of waiting until you switched tabs and came back.
### Also in this build
- Removed a duplicate close button that appeared at the top of the window alongside the one on the card itself.
